parts.label: Part 2
parts.article:
Part two.

You will hear the headteacher of Rivermead School talking to a group of journalists about facilities at the school that are open to the general public.

First, you have some time to look at questions eleven to fourteen.

Now listen carefully and answer questions eleven to fourteen.

What I'd like to do at this meeting is to tell you a bit about the facilities that Rivermead School offers people in the community.

I'd like to start by talking about the new theater that we've just opened in our school. Its mission is to maximize opportunities for local audiences to experience productions of the highest quality.

Amongst other things, this will involve offering a place where professional drama companies in the area can perform.

But there'll also be opportunities to host national and international companies, both those which are up and coming and those which have already established a reputation.

Details of our first season's theater program are already online. I hope you'll agree that it looks very exciting.

As well as music and dance, there'll be drama from modern writers, and there'll also be a high proportion of shows aimed at children and families. You'll notice that there is one empty space in November. That's because the Chinese State Acrobatic Troupe have had to cancel their visit. But hopefully, we'll be able to announce a replacement very soon.

Now, we're often asked about the theater's sources of funding. Well, a limited amount of money will come from various government subsidies, but the bulk of the revenue will be generated by the sale of tickets, which is one reason why we'd be grateful for your help in promoting the work of the theater. In addition, there are opportunities for individuals to support the theater on a regular basis through its sponsorship scheme. The benefits to donors include access to rehearsals and to show previews.

But the new theater isn't the only facility which is open to everyone. The school also has a small museum.

This holds various objects that were found when the ground was excavated to lay the foundations for the building, as well as other historical objects.

Entrance to this is free. We also have a state-of-the-art sports hall. This is reserved for our students during term time, but anyone can use it in the school holidays. And our cafeteria is worth a visit. It has a varied menu, and it's open all day to visitors as well as staff and students.

Before you hear the rest of the talk, you have some time to look at questions fifteen to twenty.

Now listen and answer questions fifteen to twenty.

Right. I'll just point out some things on the map of the school campus I've given you. First of all, the theater. That's opposite car park P two on the south side.

You're not allowed to park anywhere except in the car parks.

There are two marked on your map, P one and P two, but there's a new car park which has only just been completed, and that's at the most northern end of the campus. Some people might want to consider coming by bus. There's a good service from the city center to the school, and the bus stops at the roundabout. That's where it turns round to go back. So you have to get off there. It doesn't go up as far as Park Road.

Then to get to the sports hall, you take the right fork after the main entrance and just keep going past the classroom block.

You have to go straight across the roundabout, and it's further on, on the right-hand side of that road.

Then there's the cafeteria. There are various ways to get there because it's at the junction of Park Road and Rennie's Drive on the north side of Park Road.

In nice weather, you can sit outside to eat and admire the view.

Then the museum is fairly central. Just go left after the main entrance. Take the first turning on the right, and when you reach a junction, the museum is facing you. Now, I...

That is the end of part two. You now have thirty seconds to check your answers to part two.

questions.question: What is the main aim of the school’s new theatre?

analyses.content: 录音开头直接点明剧院的使命是让当地观众有机会体验最高质量的演出，这与B选项的“让当地人接触到好的表演”完美对应。
你可能会听到后文的“professional drama companies”或“national and international companies”并试图去选A或C，但录音明确说这些只是剧院会接待的团队，并不是剧院建立的“主要目的（main aim）”。

Its mission is to maximize opportunities for local audiences to experience productions of the highest quality. Amongst other things, this will involve offering a place where professional drama companies in the area can perform. But there'll also be opportunities to host national and international companies, both those which are up and coming and those which have already established a reputation.

questions.question: The first season’s theatre programme will include

analyses.content: 录音在罗列第一季节目的内容时，明确提到了会有现代作家的戏剧（drama from modern writers），直接对应选项A。
你如果一听到“Chinese State Acrobatic Troupe”就激动地选了B，那是没有认真听完后半句的“cancel their visit（取消访问）”，做选择题时务必警惕这种“原词重现+否定转折”的陷阱。

As well as music and dance, there'll be drama from modern writers, and there'll also be a high proportion of shows aimed at children and families. You'll notice that there is one empty space in November. That's because the Chinese State Acrobatic Troupe have had to cancel their visit.

questions.question: Most of theatre’s funding will come from

analyses.content: 录音中用“the bulk of the revenue（绝大部分收入）”来对应题干的“Most of funding”，并紧跟着给出了答案“sale of tickets（售票）”，对应选项C。
你很容易被录音里提到的“government subsidies”和“sponsorship”干扰，但政府资金前面有“limited（有限的）”修饰，而赞助只是个人的额外支持，只有仔细听出表程度的“bulk（大部分）”才能避开干扰。

Now, we're often asked about the theater's sources of funding. Well, a limited amount of money will come from various government subsidies, but the bulk of the revenue will be generated by the sale of tickets, which is one reason why we'd be grateful for your help in promoting the work of the theater. In addition, there are opportunities for individuals to support the theater on a regular basis through its sponsorship scheme.

questions.question: Which facility at the school is open to the public on a limited basis only?

analyses.content: 录音中提到体育馆（sports hall）在学期内只留给学生，只有在假期才允许任何人使用，这正好符合题干要求的“有限制地向公众开放（on a limited basis only）”。
你可能会在后面听到餐厅（cafeteria）对访客开放而犹豫，但录音明确说餐厅是全天开放（open all day）且没有限制条件，做题时一定要死死咬住“limited basis”这个限定词。

We also have a state-of-the-art sports hall. This is reserved for our students during term time, but anyone can use it in the school holidays. And our cafeteria is worth a visit. It has a varied menu, and it's open all day to visitors as well as staff and students.
录音明确给出剧院的定位是以“停车场P2”为参照物，并且在它的对面（opposite）和南侧（south side），也就是地图下方的C点。
做地图题刚上来你可能还没找到图上的关键参照物，如果没有盯紧P2的位置，听到south side很容易乱找选错。
First of all, the theater. That's opposite car park P two on the south side.
录音直接说明新停车场（new car park）在校园的最北端（most northern end），对应地图最上方孤立的E点。
录音提到了图上已经标出的P1和P2，你如果不仔细听问题问的是“new”停车场，思维可能就会在P1和P2附近打转而漏掉最北端的E。
There are two marked on your map, P one and P two, but there's a new car park which has only just been completed, and that's at the most northern end of the campus.
录音非常直接地交代了公交车停在环岛处（stops at the roundabout），也就是地图上的G点。
你可能会听到“Park Road”这个强干扰词，但说话人紧跟着就说公交车不会开到Park Road那么远（doesn't go up as far as），所以一定不能选在Park Road上的地标。

There's a good service from the city center to the school, and the bus stops at the roundabout. That's where it turns round to go back, so you have to get off there. It doesn't go up as far as Park Road.
跟着录音路线，从主入口进向右走岔路，直行穿过环岛（straight across the roundabout）后，继续往前的右手边就是体育馆，精准对应H点。
在经过环岛时如果你方向感乱了，或者没有听到“straight across（直穿过）”，极有可能提前转弯选到了旁边的I点，在地图行进中千万不能凭感觉乱拐弯。

Then to get to the sports hall, you take the right fork after the main entrance and just keep going past the classroom block. You have to go straight across the roundabout, and it's further on on the right-hand side of that road.
录音给出了两个绝对定位条件：在Park Road和Rennie's Drive的交汇处（junction），以及在Park Road的北侧（north side），两个条件交叉点即为F。
如果你只听到了交汇处（junction）却没有抓紧“north side（北侧）”这个决定性方位词，你会发现在这两条路的交汇处有好几个字母，很容易瞎蒙。
Then there's the cafeteria. There are various ways to get there because it's at the junction of Park Road and Rennie's Drive on the north side of Park Road.
录音带着你从主入口向左走，然后在第一个路口右转，到达交汇处时博物馆就在你的正对面（facing you），完美对应B点。
这是整条线上最绕的路线，你如果在“左转后第一个路口右转”时没反应过来，就一定会跟丢，这时候要赶紧抓住最后一句补救信息“facing you（正对着你）”结合前方的路口把答案锁定。
Then the museum is fairly central. Just go left after the main entrance. Take the first turning on the right, and when you reach a junction, the museum is facing you.
